purpose_comment: Mutation-testing pilot. Stryker mutates the source under test (e.g. flips < to <=, swaps + with -) and re-runs the test suite; if all tests still pass with the mutation in place, that mutation is considered 'survived' and the unit tests have a hole. The score = killed / (killed + survived). 80%+ is good for pure-logic packages.
scope_comment: Limited to mutations.ts + slides.ts to keep the run < 5 minutes. Expand by adjusting `mutate` once we have a baseline score.
run_comment: `just mutate` (or `pnpm mutate` in this package) — outputs an HTML report at reports/mutation/. CI integration is opt-in (don't gate every PR on this; run nightly or before milestone close).
root_comment: Runs from the repo root (the `mutate` script cds there): Stryker copies the working directory into a sandbox, and the vitest config reaches outside this package (../../vitest.timeouts.ts, ../shared/src). From the root the sandbox keeps the repo's layout; ignorePatterns copy only what these tests need. Paths below are relative to the root.
